purpose: Provenance and safety review for transferable Superagentic patterns in WebPent

repositories.name: Agent-Engineering-101
repositories.observed_scope: React/Vite educational slide deck about reliable agent engineering
repositories.security_review: No runtime pentesting implementation adopted; no assets or source code copied.

repositories.name: superclaw
repositories.observed_scope: Scenario-driven pre-deployment security testing for AI coding agents
repositories.security_review: Attack/adapters/reporting are not allowed to bypass WebPent ActionAuthority, scope compiler, executor, or ProofEngine.

integration_policy.license_obligation: Apache-2.0 source remains external and is not redistributed as copied WebPent code; Agent-Engineering-101 is used only as an unlicensed conceptual reference.

pattern_matrix.observed_behavior: Educational slide deck presents reliability, evaluation, memory, and agent-engineering concepts.
pattern_matrix.transferable_idea: Make reliability boundaries and evaluation explicit.
pattern_matrix.license_compatibility: Concept only; no explicit source license found.
pattern_matrix.security_risk: Low when reimplemented natively; high if slide/source assets are copied.

pattern_matrix.transferable_idea: Scenario-driven behavior testing and evidence-first reporting.
pattern_matrix.license_compatibility: Apache-2.0 permits adaptation; no source copied.
pattern_matrix.security_risk: A generic adapter could bypass target authorization if transplanted.
pattern_matrix.test_required: forbidden-action, redaction, and fail-closed behavior suites

pattern_matrix.observed_behavior: Behavior specifications expose explicit contracts and evaluation criteria.
pattern_matrix.transferable_idea: Versioned behavior scenario contracts with expected safe/progress/stop outcomes.
pattern_matrix.license_compatibility: Apache-2.0 compatible for an independent reimplementation.
pattern_matrix.security_risk: Behavior pass must never become target vulnerability confirmation.
pattern_matrix.test_required: local scenario runner and policy gate

pattern_matrix.observed_behavior: Scenario ideation, rollout, and judgment are separate stages.
pattern_matrix.transferable_idea: Separate discovery from confirmation and keep evaluation structured.
pattern_matrix.license_compatibility: Apache-2.0 compatible for an independent reimplementation.
pattern_matrix.security_risk: LLM-generated scenarios could smuggle actions or credentials.
pattern_matrix.test_required: typed proposal validation, redaction, and authority delegation

pattern_matrix.observed_behavior: Target adapters encapsulate communication, including a mock adapter.
pattern_matrix.transferable_idea: Use local deterministic adapters for behavior evaluation.
pattern_matrix.license_compatibility: Apache-2.0 compatible for an independent reimplementation.
pattern_matrix.security_risk: Direct network or arbitrary adapter execution is forbidden.
pattern_matrix.test_required: adapter registry and direct-I/O inventory checks

pattern_matrix.license_compatibility: No source copied; existing WebPent reporters retained.
pattern_matrix.security_risk: Raw prompts, credentials, or target content could leak.

pattern_matrix.observed_behavior: Authorized-only use, local-only default, and findings treated as signals until verified.
pattern_matrix.transferable_idea: Explicit local/offline safety boundary and evidence honesty.
pattern_matrix.webpent_destination: behavior scenarios, quality gate, and CURRENT_RELEASE.md
pattern_matrix.security_risk: False confidence if safety claims are not backed by tests.
pattern_matrix.test_required: scope, proof, and false-clean regression suites

rejected_components: Wholesale source copy from either repository
Any adapter that performs target I/O outside ActionAuthority/ActionExecutor
Any LLM judge that can promote a finding or override a policy block
Any browser, subprocess, or provider integration without an audited WebPent wrapper
Any pattern relying on unlicensed Agent-Engineering-101 source or assets
